title: Floor & Decor Opens New Store in Frederick, Maryland

# Floor & Decor Opens New Store in Frederick, Maryland


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_45692b67f1b099336388a7e306c8158c/flooranddecor/news/2026-11-05_Floor_Decor_Opens_New_Store_in_Frederick_312.pdf) November 05, 2026 4:35pm EST


— Leading specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring brings its expansive in-stock selection and warehouse-format shopping experience to Frederick —


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Floor & Decor (NYSE: FND), a leading specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring for professionals and homeowners, today announced the opening of its newest warehouse store and design center in Frederick, Maryland, at 1003 W. Patrick Street, Suite 13.


The Frederick store opens with a team of approximately 50 associates led by Benjamin Whitting, the store’s Chief Executive Merchant.


The new store gives Frederick-area homeowners and professionals local access to a broad assortment of in-stock tile, wood, laminate, vinyl, and natural stone options, along with installation materials, decorative accessories and related categories at everyday low prices.


“We’re proud to bring Floor & Decor to Frederick,” said Whitting. “This new store reflects our continued commitment to providing homeowners and professionals with great products, expert guidance, and strong value, all in one place. We can’t wait to connect with the community and be a trusted resource for their home projects.”


The new Frederick store opens to customers today, with a ribbon cutting ceremony and official grand opening celebration to follow on Thursday, November 12, and a PRO Grand Opening Event on Thursday, January 14, 2027.


**Ribbon Cutting Ceremony** Floor & Decor will celebrate its grand opening with a ribbon cutting ceremony on Thursday, November 12, at 10 a.m. ET, in partnership with the Frederick County Chamber of Commerce and the Washington County Chamber of Commerce.


**PRO Grand Opening Event** On Thursday, January 14, 2027, from 5 p.m. to 8 p.m. ET, the store will host a PRO Grand Opening Event for local trade professionals. Attendees will have the chance to win $10,000 cash, an iPad, an Apple Watch, a YETI cooler, a Carhartt duffle bag, and more*. Registration opens November 12. Pros can learn more and register at[flooranddecor.com/frederickpro](http://www.flooranddecor.com/frederickpro) .


*NO PURCHASE NECESSARY. Open to legal residents of DC, MD, NJ, PA and VA who reside within 250 miles of Frederick, MD, 18 and older. Must be present to win. Odds depend on number of entries. Void where prohibited. For Official Rules, visit[mdmgames.com/MDMAdmin/RulesPolicies/frederickpro_OfficialRules.html](https://www.mdmgames.com/MDMAdmin/RulesPolicies/frederickpro_OfficialRules.html)


**Store Facts** Location: 1003 W. Patrick Street, Suite 13, Frederick, MD 21702


- Store Hours: Monday–Friday 7 a.m.–8 p.m.; Saturday 8 a.m.–7 p.m.; Sunday 10 a.m.–6 p.m. ET
- Phone Number: (240) 367-9193


**About Floor & Decor Holdings, Inc.** Floor & Decor is a multi-channel specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring and related accessories and seller of commercial surfaces. As of September 24, 2026, the Company operated 282 warehouse-format stores and five design studios across 39 states. The Company offers a broad in-stock assortment of laminate and vinyl, tile, wood, and natural stone flooring and installation materials and decorative accessories, as well as adjacent categories, at everyday low prices. The Company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
